story.iWant: a floating chat button always visible in the bottom-right corner of the app, that expands into a chat panel when I click it
story.soThat: the free-agent is always one click away from any page without occupying screen real estate when I'm not using it
story.tasks:
State + scope hook: - Create src/stores/free-agent-store.ts — Zustand store with { isOpen, currentScope, activeSessionId, composerText } + actions { open, close, toggle, setScope, setComposerText }. (AC #7) - Create src/components/free-agent/use-free-agent-scope.ts — hook reading usePathname + useSearchParams; derives scope per AC rules; subscribes to route changes so the store's currentScope stays in sync. (AC #7, AC #8)
Components (src/components/free-agent/): - widget.tsx — root component. Reads isOpen; renders <Fab /> when closed, <Panel /> when open. Mounts the useFreeAgentScope subscription. (AC #1, AC #3) - fab.tsx — circular FAB 56×56px bottom-right, accent-blue, Lucide icon, tooltip. EC2-mode-aware disabled state. (AC #2, AC #9) - panel.tsx — expanded panel: fixed bottom-right, ~400×600px desktop, full-width drawer 90vh mobile. No modal backdrop. (AC #3) - panel-header.tsx — lens label ("Assistant — Project: dino-7" etc.) + placeholders for model selector/cost-burn/hamburger + close button. (AC #4, AC #8) - message-thread.tsx — scrollable thread; empty placeholder; user-right + assistant-left bubble rendering. (AC #4, AC #5) - composer.tsx — textarea (auto-grow 6 lines max), Cmd+Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, Enter newline, send button + cost-display placeholder. (AC #4, AC #6)
Global mount + EC2 gating: - Modify src/app/layout.tsx — mount <FreeAgentWidget /> inside the auth-gated wrapper. (AC #1) - Wire EC2 mode from existing Ec2Toggle store/hook into the FAB component. (AC #9)
Playwright smoke: - Create tests/e2e/free-agent-widget.smoke.spec.ts — FAB visible on authed page, click opens panel with Workspace lens, navigation updates lens, close button closes, re-open preserves composer text. Reuse the auth-pre-seed pattern from tests/e2e/party.smoke.spec.ts. (AC #10)
Validation: - npm run ci end-to-end. (AC #12)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC #1 — <FreeAgentWidget /> mounted globally from src/app/layout.tsx, hidden pre-auth. AC #2 — FAB at rest: 56×56px circular, fixed bottom-right (24/24), z-index 50, accent-blue, soft shadow, Lucide chat-bubble icon, tooltip "Open free agent". AC #3 — Click → expanded panel ~400×600px desktop / full-width drawer 90vh mobile. No modal backdrop. AC #4 — Panel structure: header (lens label + placeholders + close), thread, composer. Cost-burn + model selector + hamburger are placeholder slots (Stories 18.5/18.6 wire them). AC #5 — Empty placeholder "Send a message to start". User-right + assistant-left bubble rendering. Streaming wiring deferred to 18.5. AC #6 — Composer: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends; Shift+Enter and bare Enter insert newline. AC #7 — Zustand store { isOpen, currentScope, activeSessionId, composerText } + actions { open, close, toggle, setScope, setComposerText }. useFreeAgentScope derives scope from pathname/searchParams. AC #8 — Lens updates on navigation while panel is open + "Scope changed — start new conversation?" callout (does NOT auto-fork; explicit user action only). AC #9 — EC2 mode local → FAB disabled/greyed + tooltip "Switch to EC2 to use the free agent". AC #10 — Playwright smoke covers FAB visibility, open + Workspace lens, navigate + lens update, close, re-open preserves composer. AC #11 — Conventions: kebab-case files, named exports only, @/ imports, Prettier 3 defaults, ESLint 9 max-warnings 0. AC #12 — npm run ci passes with no new regressions beyond the known pre-existing baseline (4 epic-dev-pipeline failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck errors + 4 pre-existing agent-daemon.mjs lint warnings + knip warnings).

story-context.constraints: - Pure UI story. NO backend changes. Stories 18.5 and 18.6 wire send/stream/persist. [Source: epic Story 18.4] - Mount globally inside the auth-gated wrapper, NOT at the page-content level. The widget must only appear post-auth. [Source: AC #1 + CLAUDE.md DEPLOY SAFETY rationale] - Motion polish (Sue Render's breathing pulse + spring open/close + reduced-motion fallback) is deferred to Story 18.7. v1 ships with default `transition: all 0.2s ease`. [Source: memory feedback_ship_mvp_add_later; story Dev Notes] - EC2 toggle reuse: read mode from existing Ec2Toggle store/hook; do NOT duplicate that state. [Source: AC #9 + existing Story 15.x pattern] - Conventions: kebab-case files, named exports only, no default exports, @/* imports, Prettier 3 defaults, ESLint 9 max-warnings 0, Tailwind 4 utility classes. [Source: CLAUDE.md Key Conventions] - No SSR — all state client-side. Zustand store hydrates from defaults; useFreeAgentScope updates on route change. [Source: CLAUDE.md Next.js output: 'export'] - Scope derivation order: project (labs/projects/:id, labs/party/:id) > plan (labs/plans/:id, labs?planId=) > app (apps/:id) > workspace (fallback). [Source: AC #4] - Composer keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends, Shift+Enter and bare Enter insert newline. Prevents accidental sends. [Source: AC #6] - No new dependencies added. Reuse existing zustand, lucide-react, shadcn primitives. [Source: existing package.json] - npm run ci must pass with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline. [Source: Story 18.3 CI summary]

tests.standards: Vitest for unit/component tests (jsdom env, @/ alias). For this story most tests are Playwright smoke-level: the panel rendering, FAB visibility, lens transition, composer text persistence. No deep interaction tests for keyboard handling in this story (those land naturally in Story 18.5 when send is wired). Reuse the auth-pre-seed pattern from tests/e2e/party.smoke.spec.ts (sessionStorage). Reuse page.route() interceptor pattern for the EC2-mode mocking. No backend tests (no new backend).
